standard.coverage: ALL employers regardless of size. Minnesota's large-employer / small-employer split ENDED on 2025-01-01 -- a table still carrying two Minnesota rates is out of date.
standard.note: Minn. Stat. 177.24 annual inflation adjustment (capped at 5%). 2027: $11.87 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Minn. Stat. 177.24 subd. 2 -- Minnesota has never allowed a tip credit.

youthAndTraining.label: 90-day training wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 CONSECUTIVE days of employment -- Minn. Stat. 177.24 subd. 1(f). Also the figure Minnesota publishes for youth (under 18) and J-1 visa hotel/resort employees.

sources.title: Minnesota DLI -- minimum-wage rate adjusted for inflation as of Jan. 1, 2027
sources.verifiedBy: Search result from dli.mn.gov (Aug 19, 2026): 'Minnesota's minimum-wage rate will be adjusted for inflation on Jan. 1, 2027, to $11.87 an hour for all employers in the state.' The 90-day training wage ($9.68) is cross-source only (HiveDesk), not read on a DLI page.

sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session: '$11.41 an hour' and the '$9.31 an hour' 90-day training wage, both effective 2026-01-01, and no large/small employer distinction remaining.
